name: Viewpoint Inside Volume Ray Setup
aliases: Viewpoint Inside Volume Ray Setup — Hybrid ray setup, Polygonal geometry intersection
definition: A technique to allow the viewpoint to be inside the volume (e.g., virtual colonoscopy) by intersecting the ray with polygonal geometry instead of just a bounding box.
summary: Viewpoint Inside Volume Ray Setup enables volume ray casting from inside the volume by intersecting rays with explicit polygonal geometry to correct entry points and clip internal surfaces.
